case_analysis.thread_summary: Short internal quoting thread (91 lines) for Soar / NTT Sonority A2DP/AVRCP/IOPT profile certification project. Sakai established the prerequisites that must be confirmed before the project can be scoped: certified module QDID, certified Host Stack QDID with clean ICS, and Host Stack must cover AVCTP, AVDTP, and GADTP. Quote estimate: PTS test ¥300K + Multi-Design reference fee ¥250K + wire transfer fee ¥100K + SIG Qualification Fee ($6,000 USD equivalent). This thread is a precursor to thread_0151, which covers the actual project execution.
all_questions_found: What prerequisites must be verified before scoping an A2DP/AVRCP/IOPT profile test project?
case_analysis.key_technical_discussion: A2DP and AVRCP require AVCTP, AVDTP, and GADTP to be present in the Host Stack QDID. These protocols are the transport layer for audio/video control and data — without them, the profile layer has no valid base to build on in the SIG qualification framework.
case_analysis.key_decision_logic: Prerequisites gate the project: if Host Stack does not cover the required protocol layers, the quote and scope must change. Always verify ICS cleanliness before committing to scope.
case_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: Under-scoping by missing a Host Stack gap means the customer gets an underpriced quote but faces a much larger bill when the gap is discovered mid-project.
case_analysis.consulting_mistake: No mistakes in this thread — Sakai correctly identified the prerequisites before issuing any quote.
case_analysis.consulting_takeaway: For A2DP/AVRCP projects, always verify the Host Stack QDID includes AVCTP, AVDTP, and GADTP before quoting. This is a standard pre-quote checklist item for audio profile projects.
